<p align="center"><strong>Build the lantern that can carry the ward upstairs.</strong></p>

<p align="center"><small><strong>Inventory:</strong> Brass key &middot; Moonseed &middot; Copper coil &middot; Black cat companion</small></p>


<p align="center">The bench holds an empty lantern frame, a glass lens and three circuit positions. Every tool has been tied down, as though someone feared the house would move it.</p>

<p align="center">You set down the moonseed and coil. The shadow in the doorway stops at the edge of their light. Both items remain with you as parts of the lantern.</p>

<p align="center">A diagram and an unsent letter lie beneath the lens. Across the window, a finger writes: &quot;He invited me.&quot;</p>
